notes: Embedded columnar/vectorised OLAP engine; single process (multiple cursors share one database handle), parallel query execution, no replication.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  parent_id INTEGER,
  name VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  depth INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  payload JSON,
  value_num DECIMAL(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)

q02_range_scan.title: Range scan on unindexed timestamp + status filter
q02_range_scan.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, status, total_amount FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00' AND status = 'delivered' ORDER BY ordered_at, id LIMIT 500

q03_join_agg.title: 3-way join + GROUP BY month/country + ORDER BY revenue
q03_join_agg.sql: SELECT c.country_code, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.country_code, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.country_code, month_start LIMIT 50

q04_window_rank.title: Top-3 products per category (ROW_NUMBER over aggregate)
q04_window_rank.sql: SELECT category_id, product_id, revenue, rn FROM (SELECT p.category_id, oi.product_id, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) DESC, oi.product_id) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id, oi.product_id) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY category_id, rn

q05_window_running.title: Running total + LAG over daily revenue
q05_window_running.sql: SELECT d, daily, SUM(daily) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running, LAG(daily, 1) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS prev_day FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS d, SUM(total_amount) AS daily FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at)) s ORDER BY d

q06_recursive_cte.title: Recursive CTE over category tree (path strings)
q06_recursive_cte.sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree (id, parent_id, name, depth, path) AS (SELECT id, parent_id, name, 0, CAST(name AS VARCHAR(400)) FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, t.depth + 1, CAST(t.path || ' > ' || c.name AS VARCHAR(400)) FROM categories c JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id) SELECT id, depth, path FROM tree ORDER BY path

q07_cte_cohort.title: Chained CTEs: cohort retention
q07_cte_cohort.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(ordered_at) AS first_at FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id), cohorts AS (SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', first_at) AS cohort FROM first_orders), activity AS (SELECT o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS m FROM orders o GROUP BY o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)) SELECT c.cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS active_later FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id AND a.m > c.cohort GROUP BY c.cohort ORDER BY c.cohort

q08_exists_semijoin.title: EXISTS / NOT EXISTS semi- and anti-joins
q08_exists_semijoin.sql: SELECT c.id, c.email FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.customer_id = c.id AND e.event_type = 'churn') ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 200

q09_correlated_scalar.title: Correlated scalar subquery per row
q09_correlated_scalar.sql: SELECT p.id, p.price, (SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id) AS cat_avg FROM products p WHERE p.active = TRUE ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 500

q10_lateral_topn.title: LATERAL / CROSS APPLY top-N per customer
q10_lateral_topn.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, o.id AS order_id, o.ordered_at, o.total_amount FROM customers c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o2.id, o2.ordered_at, o2.total_amount FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o2.ordered_at DESC, o2.id DESC LIMIT 3) o WHERE c.id <= 100 ORDER BY c.id, o.ordered_at DESC

q10b_topn_window.title: Top-N per customer via ROW_NUMBER (portable alternative to LATERAL)
q10b_topn_window.sql: SELECT customer_id, id AS order_id, ordered_at, total_amount FROM (SELECT customer_id, id, ordered_at, total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE customer_id <= 100) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY customer_id, ordered_at DESC

q11_grouping_sets.title: GROUPING SETS / ROLLUP multi-level aggregate
q11_grouping_sets.sql: SELECT shipping_country, status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((shipping_country, status), (shipping_country), ()) ORDER BY shipping_country, status

q12_json_filter.title: Filter on JSON attributes (text + numeric extraction)
q12_json_filter.sql: SELECT id, sku, price FROM products WHERE (attrs->>'$.color') = 'red' AND CAST((attrs->>'$.weight') AS DOUBLE) > 10 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

q13_fulltext.title: Full-text search on product descriptions
q13_fulltext.sql: SELECT id, name FROM products WHERE fts_main_products.match_bm25(id, 'bluetooth waterproof') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 50

q14_upsert.title: UPSERT (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT / ON DUPLICATE KEY / MERGE)
q14_upsert.sql: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, warehouse_id, qty, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (product_id, warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET qty = inventory.qty + excluded.qty, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

q15_merge.title: SQL-standard MERGE with matched/not-matched branches
q15_merge.sql: MERGE INTO inventory i USING (SELECT CAST(? AS INTEGER) AS product_id, CAST(? AS INTEGER) AS warehouse_id, CAST(? AS INTEGER) AS qty ) s ON (i.product_id = s.product_id AND i.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET qty = i.qty + s.qty, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (product_id, warehouse_id, qty, updated_at) VALUES (s.product_id, s.warehouse_id, s.qty, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

q16_offset_pagination.title: Deep OFFSET pagination (anti-pattern)
q16_offset_pagination.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, ordered_at FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at, id LIMIT 50 OFFSET 100000

q17_keyset_pagination.title: Keyset pagination (expanded predicate)

q17b_keyset_rowvalue.title: Keyset pagination with row-value comparison
q17b_keyset_rowvalue.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE (ordered_at, id) > (TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00', 0) ORDER BY ordered_at, id LIMIT 50

q18_count_distinct.title: COUNT(DISTINCT) over 1M-row table
q18_count_distinct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS uniq FROM events WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'

q19_anti_join.title: Anti-join via LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
q19_anti_join.sql: SELECT p.id FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.id

q19b_not_exists.title: Anti-join via NOT EXISTS
q19b_not_exists.sql: SELECT p.id FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.id

q20_gaps_islands.title: Sessionisation (gaps-and-islands with LAG)
q20_gaps_islands.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM (SELECT customer_id, occurred_at, prev_at, CASE WHEN prev_at IS NULL OR date_diff('second', prev_at, occurred_at) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM (SELECT customer_id, occurred_at, LAG(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY occurred_at, id) AS prev_at FROM events WHERE customer_id <= 2000) w) s WHERE new_session = 1 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id

q21_percentile.title: Median (PERCENTILE_CONT) per country
q21_percentile.sql: SELECT shipping_country, quantile_cont(total_amount, 0.5) AS median FROM orders GROUP BY shipping_country ORDER BY shipping_country

q22_string_agg.title: String aggregation (STRING_AGG / GROUP_CONCAT / LISTAGG)
q22_string_agg.sql: SELECT o.id, STRING_AGG(p.sku, ',' ORDER BY p.sku) AS skus FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.id <= 500 GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id

q23_case_pivot.title: Conditional aggregation pivot
q23_case_pivot.sql: SELECT c.country_code, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country_code ORDER BY c.country_code
